source: NOAA NCEI Global Historical Tsunami Database (events + run-ups)
notes: cause: NCEI cause code (1 earthquake, 2 questionable eq, 3 eq+landslide, 4 volcano+eq, 5 volcano+eq+landslide, 6 volcano, 7 volcano+landslide, 8 landslide, 0 unknown). validity 2 questionable, 3 probable, 4 definite. maxH = max water height m (-1 unknown). level 0-5 from Soloviev–Imamura intensity of maxH. place = index into earthquakes.json places[]. eq/vol = NCEI linked event ids. Years are astronomical (0 = 1 BC, -4999 = 5000 BC). Month/day 0 = unknown. Dates are kept as recorded by the source (Julian before 1582-10-15, as is conventional in the catalogues); the game calendar is proleptic Gregorian.
